retrievalProfile.description: A warm-toned studio portrait of three women in white attire against a sandy backdrop, featuring a large stylized script title and a clean serif subtitle.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-glamour studio composition featuring three women posed dynamically on a sandy surface. The lighting is warm and diffused, emphasizing gold jewelry and white fabric. The layout uses a large, expressive script for the primary title at the top and a spaced-out serif for the secondary text at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between white clothing and warm tan background
Large-scale script title overlapping the subjects
Symmetrical balance between top and bottom text blocks
coreInvariants: Subjects wearing white fabric wraps or swimwear
Prominent gold and pearl statement jewelry

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects occupy the central and lower two-thirds of the frame in a tiered, reclining arrangement.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The woman on the right with high-volume hair acts as the vertical anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large 'S' in the top left, follows the title across, drops to the central figures, and rests on the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Open space at the top and bottom edges provides room for typography.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold jewelry and red-orange drop shadows
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, low to medium saturation with warm undertones.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones, white, and gold

letterConstructionRules: Title features an oversized initial 'S' with a long tail
Script letters are thin, upright, and widely spaced
Subtitle uses a high-contrast serif with wide tracking
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' is elongated vertically to act as a framing element
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive, large-scale script paired with a formal, widely-spaced serif for stability.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the upright, thin calligraphic feel of the title
Provides the high-contrast serif look for the subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio photograph of three women with 80s-style voluminous hair, wearing white fabric wraps and gold jewelry, reclining on a sandy floor against a beige wall. Warm, soft lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, thin, yellow script title at the top with wide spacing and a red drop shadow. Add a small, all-caps black serif subtitle at the bottom with very wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the initial 'S' significantly larger than other letters?
Is the subtitle text widely spaced?
Is the color palette strictly warm tones and white?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the script title does not obscure faces
Ensure the sand texture is visible but not distracting
Verify the gold jewelry has a metallic sheen
Confirm the subtitle is perfectly centered
recipe.reuseFormula: Warm studio lighting + trio reclining pose + white/gold styling + wide-tracked serif footer.
